name: StoryVue
tagline: A hands-free reading assistant that reads printed pages aloud to visually impaired children and explains them.
problem: Visually impaired children struggle to read printed material independently.
solution: OCR captures page text, a language model reads, summarises and explains it, and the whole interaction runs by voice with no buttons.
demo_moment: Team-described: hold up a page and ask the app to explain it.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Fully voice-driven, so the child never needs to see the screen.

lessons: Design the whole interaction around the sense the user has.
